title: New requests whose work began before the Commission heard them
question: How often does a department ask for approval of contracting out after the contract has already started?
finding: 25 new requests give a start date more than 30 days before the meeting that heard them. Technology 44123-22/23 ($7.5 million, started 2015-11-01, heard 2022-11-07); City Administrator 46300-23/24 ($2.5 million, started 2020-08-01, heard 2024-01-30); Technology 46561-22/23 ($5.2 million, started 2020-08-28, heard 2023-01-25).
how: New requests only. Start date is the estimated start on the older form or “First Contract Start Date” on the newer one, compared with the meeting date of the packet.
limits: The Commission’s 2023 rules added software support and other categories to its review, so some contracts already running were brought in after the fact (the Technology request for Adobe software says so); emergency contracts can also start first. A start date is the department’s estimate.
